svg.title: Figure 16 · Total-variance wing behavior
svg.desc: Reference one-year SSVI continued to k in [-5,5]. The slope-2 line is an asymptotic comparison, not a pointwise upper bound at finite strikes; portions above the plotted range are clipped.
